evidence.why: Exact current reads, arithmetic, comparisons and outputs.

facts.rationale: Preserves the existing data-flow interpretation while correcting the current indexed stick-input member spelling and making both guards explicit.
facts.value: Reads input.lstick[0].x, cmd_vars[0], lstick_angle and Luigi attributes x58, x5C and x60. While cmd_vars[0] is zero, stick direction magnitude above x5C is normalized by (1 - x5C), scaled by x60 and converted to a signed radian angle. Positive horizontal input selects the negative sign. The candidate replaces lstick_angle only when its absolute magnitude is strictly greater. Independently, ftCheckThrowB3 and absolute horizontal input above x58 permit ftCommon_UpdateFacing, followed by ftPartSetRotY(fp, 0, M_PI_2 * fp->facing_dir).

facts.rationale: Corrects terminal_vel to terminal_velocity while preserving both exclusive paths and full-vector scaling.
facts.value: Reads cmd_vars[0] as a zero/nonzero selector. Zero forwards x68_LUIGI_SUPERJUMP_GRAVITY_START and co_attrs.terminal_velocity to ftCommon_Fall, then passes fp to ftCommon_8007CF58. Nonzero passes gobj to ft_80085154, then multiplies self_vel.x, self_vel.y and self_vel.z in place by x6C_LUIGI_SUPERJUMP_VEL_Y and returns. The body contains no direct command-variable write or motion-state transition.
